results: Visitor reading is identity-free; 800ms drafts survive close/reload and stay separate for each response
A visitor can heart and undo a heart with one server reaction per identity
Anonymous participation adopts the visitor draft, posts the remembered name, and updates the shared comment count
Another unsigned visitor reads the comment but has no author delete control
A lost successful POST can be retried without duplicate comments or overriding an intentionally blank name
Typing during a pending comment save preserves the newer unpublished draft
Closing and reopening during a save keeps the target locked, restores the draft, and retries without duplicating the saved comment
The author can delete their own nested comment and its count updates
Account names prefill automatically and sign-out closes the thread and isolates the account draft
WebKit at 320px fits the thread, comments and draft composer with readable touch inputs
